Between two consecutive diagonal visits at (a,a) and (b,b) (gap k=b-a) the path stays strictly on one side of y=x, so the number of such segments is f(k) = 2*C_{k-1} (C = Catalan): f(1)=2, f(2)=2, f(3)=4, f(4)=10, f(5)=28, f(6)=84, f(7)=264, f(8)=858, f(9)=2860, f(10)=9724. A path visiting exactly 3 interior diagonal points 0<a<b<c<10 counts f(a)f(b-a)f(c-b)f(10-c), so the total is the sum over compositions of 10 into 4 positive parts of the product of f's. Equivalently the recurrence g(p,t) = sum_{q>p} f(q-p) g(q,t-1) with g(10,0)=1 gives, for t = 0..9 touches: 9724, 19448, 27456, 32032, 32032, 27456, 19712, 11264, 4608, 1024 (these sum to C(20,10)=184756 as a check).
